bundle.name: stark-implement
bundle.description: Autonomously execute a development phase end-to-end — implement, PR, review, fix, merge, release — via a paired lead/wing agent loop. Maps to spec-kit's implement phase.

artifacts.name: stark-build
artifacts.description: Stage 2 — autonomous implementation from an accepted stark-author spec: one fresh headless session per task, gated by checks the agent cannot edit (PreToolUse path-deny + Stop-hook gate), evidence per task, commit per green task, held-out e2e gate, one cross-vendor advisory review, ONE bounded fix round for medium+ findings, draft PR. No LLM review loops. Use for build, implement a spec.

artifacts.name: stark-copilot
artifacts.description: Autonomous lead/wing implementation: lead subagent implements, wing subagent reviews, fix-loop until wing approves. Use for copilot, paired build.
